title: Duel dawn — resist the tempting cuts
source_passage: Two swordsmen faced each other in the frost. Ser Cadel saluted with his blade, the steel catching the first pale light. His opponent said nothing. Ser Cadel saluted with his blade again, as if the first time had not counted. The whole duel was, ultimately, a meditation on the impermanence of honour. Their breath smoked in the cold.
